notes.title: Demo available
notes.notes:
Hi,

Limouzik has now a demo, if you want to try our game/software!

It includes one game mode and you'll have access to the premium with the piano only!

notes.title: [4.0.0] Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Resign of Profil Manager
[*] Fix Says Game
[*] Fix Main Volume slider collider
[*] MIDIOUT : Fix low velocity (between 0 and 63 instead of 0 and 127)
[*] Multiple minor bug fix
[*] Improve performance
[/list]

notes.title: [4.0.0-RC6] Unity3D update
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New design
[*] New settings interface
[*] By default now application starts on Cursus to help new Player on-boarding
[*] Recorder improved
[*] Add speed parameter in Says and Cursus
[*] Add step number in Says
[*] Add animation on key in Cursus to help Player to identify Key to play.
[*] Add Dynamic melodie by fondamentale for key between B and Shift.
[*] New color code for basses and accompagnements keys : Brown keys always in tune and Green keys other notes or chords of the scale.
[*] Multiple bugs fixes
[*] Add Replay and Demo button in Says and Cursus
[*] F7 function key fixed
[*] Name of chords from Limouziker showned on Fondamentale key
[/list]

notes.title: [3.2.1] Update + News 4.0.0
notes.notes:
[3.2.1]
The update improves the implementation of the Steam workshop, fixes bugs and improves security.

[4.0.0 Coming soon]
The 4.0.0 update is being developed on Unity3D to improve performance, improve the design and especially to allow us to integrate several modes of additional games.
